name: Seeping Palm
description: Press a palm that lets hot qi seep into the target and keep burning after the hand lifts.

name: Viscous Guard
description: Coat the arms in thick slow qi that catches a blow and drags its force to a stop.

name: Ooze Step
description: Flow the weight from one foot to the next in a slow glide that is hard to catch.

name: Dense Jab
description: Pack the fist with heavy hot qi and jab so the blow lands with more mass than it seems to hold.

name: Flowing Burn
description: Strike and keep a palm on the target while a slow tongue of heat crawls out through the body.

name: Engulfing Flow
description: Pour thick molten qi over the foe's legs until it cools around them and holds them fast.

name: Ballast Palm
description: Drop the whole weight into a palm filled with dense qi and press it through the guard.

name: Dense Kick
description: Swing a kick that feels like a block of cooling stone against the foe's thigh.

name: Leaden Stance
description: Set a stance as heavy as lead so that rushes and shoves cannot shift the body.

name: Sinking Step
description: Press each foot down into the ground and draw the body forward on the grip of that weight.

name: Crushing Heat
description: Bear down with a hot forearm on the foe's guard until the arm underneath begins to buckle.

name: Press Guard
description: Press the weighted forearm down on an incoming limb and drive it into the ground.

name: Magma Weight
description: Lay a hand on the foe and let the dense hot qi press down until their limbs grow heavy and slow.

name: Molten Crush
description: Bring down a heavy hot blow that breaks the foe's footing along with their guard.

name: Glass Edge
description: Chill the edge of the hand to glass and draw it across the foe's arm.

name: Glassy Chop
description: Chop down with a forearm cooled to a black glassy blade that bites into the target.

name: Razor Rind
description: Raise a sharp glassy rind over the forearms that cuts the hands of any who strike it.

name: Sharp Ward
description: Hold a ring of keen cooled flakes about the body that bite at anything entering it.

name: Glassflake Flick
description: Flick a cooled chip of glassy qi from the thumb that stings at the foe's eyes.

name: Obsidian Edge
description: Cool the whole arm to a black blade in the instant of the cut and sweep it through the guard.

name: Shard Spray
description: Shatter a cooled sheet of qi in front of the user so shards fan out and cut those near.

name: Armor Sear
description: Press a glowing palm to the foe's armor so the plate heats until it scorches the skin beneath.

name: Slackening Palm
description: Heat the foe's guard arm with a touch so the muscle slackens and the block weakens.

name: Brand Press
description: Press a hot palm hard to the chest and leave a lasting mark that drains the foe's resolve.

name: Scorching Block
description: Block with a forearm so hot that the striking hand recoils from the burn.

name: Rivulet Step
description: Run on a thin line of glowing qi laid ahead of the foot and find a way round the guard.

name: Droop Touch
description: Touch the foe's weapon hand with a wave of heat that makes the wrist droop.

name: Armor Melt
description: Hold a blazing palm on the foe's plate until the metal sags and the wearer feels the full heat.

name: Molten Seam
description: Drive a white-hot fingertip into the joint of the foe's armor and burn through to flesh.

name: Sagging Blow
description: Strike a limb already softened by heat so it folds under the blow instead of resisting.

name: Lava Burst
description: Spit a gout of molten qi from the palm that lands in a hot splash on the target.

name: Spewing Palm
description: Thrust the palm out and spew a thick stream of hot qi in a short line.

name: Blister Burst
description: Raise swollen blisters of hot qi on the ground that burst and scatter heat around the user.

name: Spatter Guard
description: Fling a spatter of molten qi before the body that sears anything coming through it.

name: Bursting Step
description: Burst a small jet of heat from the heel to throw the body a full pace forward.

name: Magma Burst
description: Hurl a large burst of molten qi to the ground so it spills in a hot wave over all nearby.

name: Gouting Fist
description: Drive a fist that spurts a gout of hot qi on landing and throws the foe off balance.
